prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website homepage direction preview, landscape 1440-by-1000 proportions.
Primary request: Create a polished conventional campaign homepage for Julia Adele Callahan. Use a familiar professional campaign website structure and retain the supplied football headline. This is a practical website viewport, not a physical poster or collage.
Structure: compact navy masthead with white joinjulia.com and navigation My story / Priorities. A generously spaced white hero has Democrats on offense in large navy type, Julia Adele Callahan prominently below, For Bibb County Democratic Party Chair in supporting text, and a red Explore the priorities link-button. A right-side rectangular photographic area is explicitly a tasteful navy placeholder labeled Campaign photo to be supplied; do not draw a person. Below the hero a navy priorities band contains four clear columns with the complete issue names; below that begin a white My story section with the two story labels. Use restrained familiar sans typography, clear hierarchy, broad margins and simple square buttons. Keep football field marks subtle in the navy placeholder.
Palette: white #FFFFFF, navy #102E65, campaign red #D53B36. Avoid retro poster effects; execute the familiar website with careful typography and spacing.
Text verbatim: joinjulia.com; My story; Priorities; Democrats on offense; Julia Adele Callahan; For Bibb County Democratic Party Chair; Explore the priorities; Campaign photo to be supplied; Jail & public safety reform; Election accessibility; Healthcare; Education; How my business started; My journey into politics.
Constraints: show the missing photo honestly, not an invented likeness. No policy specifics, endorsements, election dates, statistics, fundraising, fake forms, testimonials, glows, browser frame or watermarks. All four issue names must be readable.
